subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this gateway lifecycle change show a live WeChat A+B QR-login result before merge, or is the focused gateway regression evidence sufficient for an explicit proof override?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound on the reviewed head, but only a real provider session can confirm the user-visible account continuity outcome and the contributor has no approved WeChat environment.

options.title: Require live A+B proof
options.body: Have someone with a real WeChat setup capture redacted logs or a recording showing account A stays online after account B logs in.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: A gateway owner may explicitly accept the focused regression, typecheck, build, and CI evidence as sufficient despite the missing provider-level run.

options.title: Pause for an environment
options.body: Keep the PR open without further code churn until a suitable live WeChat test setup becomes available.

recommendation.title: Require live A+B proof
recommendation.body: Have someone with a real WeChat setup capture redacted logs or a recording showing account A stays online after account B logs in.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the current gateway reload-suppression and channel-startup lifecycle boundaries.
